newsitem.title: USA: Lincoln National president to head American States.
newsitem.headline: Lincoln National president to head American States.

text.p: Lincoln National Corp said Monday that Robert Anker, currently president and chief operating officer, will become chairman and chief executive officer of American States Financial Corp.
Anker will succeed F. Cedric McCurley, who will retire on January 1, 1997.
Lincoln National owns about 63 percent of American States, which became a publicly traded company in May 1996.
Bill Lawson, who was named American States' president and chief operating officer in October 1995, will remain in that job, focused primarily on business development and sales.
Ian Rolland, chairman and chief executive officer of Lincoln National, will assume the post of president as of January 1. No chief operating officer was named.

Other executive changes at Lincoln National include H. Thomas McMeekin, currently vice president and chief investment officer, who will relinquish his post as chief executive officer of Lincoln National Investment Cos. Instead, he will focus on Lincoln National's nearly $40 billion of invested assets, the company said.

Jeffrey Nick, managing director of Lincoln National (UK), will be chief executive officer of Lincoln National Investment. Gabriel Shaheen, president and chief executive officer of Lincoln National Reinsurance Cos, will be managing director of Lincoln National (UK).

Lawrence Rowland, senior vice president of Lincoln National Reinsurance, will be president and chief executive officer of Lincoln National Reinsurance. Jon Boscia, president of Lincoln National Life Insurance Co, will also become chief executive officer of Lincoln National Life.
